market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed-hike bets and oil-driven inflation. S&P 500 likely range-bound to slightly lower. Tech/AI names provide support but Broadcom's mixed reaction signals caution. Oil at $97 caps consumer sentiment. Expect volatility into CPI data. Dollar weakness supports gold and EM but may reverse.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally bullish (GPT-6, Anthropic IPO, Tesla robotaxi). Energy transition and geopolitical risk support defense and energy. Consumer bifurcation persists. Fed policy uncertainty is the primary macro risk. 12-month view: selective outperformance in AI, energy, defense; underperformance in rate-sensitive and high-beta consumer.
